execution_branch_parent_note: A01 evidence commit; branch intentionally retains predecessor history while main has advanced. A02 integration will be isolated after A01 dependency resolves.
hypothesis: Periodic private-Xvfb root screenshots (xwd, nominal 10 ms cadence) increase missed persisted effects by at least 0.20 over both endpoint-only MINIMAL and equal-cadence SHAM under a 100 ms deadline in a disposable Tk fixture.

decision.method_valid_gate: Exactly 180 starts/schedules/actions/deadline snapshots; exact randomized input order; balanced allocation; action delay exactly 90 ms and timer arm offset 0..5 ms; callback not earlier than its own arm+90 ms; complete independent deadline records; zero integrity/screenshot errors.
decision.late_callback: A callback after the 100 ms deadline remains an outcome, not a method STOP.
decision.stable_control: At least 29/30 effects present at deadline in each arm.
decision.h_pass: SENSITIVE screenshot miss rate exceeds each control by at least 0.20 and one-sided exact paired McNemar p<=0.05 against both controls.
decision.otherwise: Method-valid data => H_FAIL_SCOPED; integrity/incomplete run => STOP/HOLD; no rerun or post-outcome tuning.
